BOOKKEEPING PROPOSAL

CAHOOTS THEATRE COMPANY

JULY 2026

PROPOSED BY
sympl

SCOPE & SERVICES

Biweekly Bookkeeping

• Process all entries in QuickBooks Online (expenses and revenue)
• Record and categorize all bank & credit card transactions
• Project / class tracking on all transactions (data provided by Client)
• Oversee Accounts Receivable and Payable functions

Monthly Reconciliations

• Monthly reconciliations of Payables, Receivables, Credit card & Bank accounts
• All monthly reconciliations to be completed within 7 business days of receiving previous month’s credit card and bank statements

Expense Management & Accounts Receivable via Google Form or HubDocs

• Client responsible for uploading receipts either via Google Form or HubDocs
• Client responsible for uploading approved grants through Google Form

Payroll Processing via WagePoint (upto 3 Employees)

• Payroll payments via direct deposit through WagePoint
• Includes employee change management including adding employees, removing employees, issuign ROEs
• Annual preparation and filing of T4s and T4As

Monthly Financial Statements and Virtual Monthly or Biweekly Check-ins

• Statement of Operations (P&L - including actuals bs budget)
• Balance sheet
• Cash flow statement
• AR/AP aging report
• Deferred revenue schedule

Sales Tax Compliance and Year-end

• Detailed review of each ledger account & posting of accruals where necessary
• Preparation of financial reports for the tax preparer or auditor
• Coordination with the tax preparer & facilitation of any additional requests
• GST/HST and/or PSB tax filing
• Year-end meeting to review financial results and discuss the upcoming year
• Annual budget posted to QBO for Actuals vs Budget tracking

FEES

Monthly Fees: $575/month + HST

This package includes:
✔  Emails and biweekly / monthly meetings for inquiries and support
✔  Ongoing support for bookkeeping, payroll processing and standard financial reporting

The following charges are not included in the monthly fee:

• Software subscriptions: The cost of software subscriptions must be maintained by the Client. This includes QBO, Plooto, Wagepoint and HubDocs (if used). Following would be the approx add’t fees:
QBO: $30/month (first 6 months $3/month - current offer)
HubDocs: $12 USD (~16CAD / month) - optional
Plooto + WagePoint: remain as per current since paid by client

• Bookkeeping backlog: Any prior period bookkeeping clean-up or catch-up work will be quoted separately based on the volume and complexity
